ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a compass-style circular disk, with N at the top, E on the right, S at the bottom, and W on the left; the center arrow initially points to the left, that is, west. Reasoning: According to the specified method, take clockwise as the positive direction and counterclockwise as the negative direction. The net number of turns of the two rotations is 2 1/4 - 3 3/4 = -1 1/2 turns, so it is equivalent to turning counterclockwise 1 1/2 turns. Starting from west, a complete 1 turn returns to west, and the remaining 1/2 turn turns to the opposite direction, that is, east.

raw_record.question_text: Initially, a spinner points west. Chenille moves it clockwise $2\frac{1}{4}$ revolutions and then counterclockwise $3\frac{3}{4}$ revolutions. In what direction does the spinner point after the two moves?

method.method_draft: Use signed net rotation. Read from the image that the compass directions are arranged N at top, E at right, S at bottom, W at left, and the spinner initially points west. From the text, take the two rotations: clockwise 2 1/4 revolutions and counterclockwise 3 3/4 revolutions. Treat clockwise as positive and counterclockwise as negative, giving net rotation 2 1/4 - 3 3/4 = -1 1/2 revolutions, i.e. 1 1/2 revolutions counterclockwise. Discard the full 1 revolution because it returns to the same direction; the remaining 1/2 revolution from west points to east.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个罗盘式圆盘，N 在上方，E 在右方，S 在下方，W 在左方；中心箭头最初指向左边，也就是 west。推理：按指定方法，把顺时针看作正方向，逆时针看作负方向。两次转动的净转数为 2 1/4 - 3 3/4 = -1 1/2 圈，所以等价于逆时针转 1 1/2 圈。从 west 出发，完整的 1 圈会回到 west，剩下的 1/2 圈会转到相反方向，也就是 east。

method.method_draft: Track the spinner after each move using quarter-turn landmarks. Read from the image the order of directions around the circle: moving clockwise from west goes north, east, south, west, and moving counterclockwise from west goes south, east, north, west. From the text, the first move is 2 1/4 clockwise revolutions: the 2 full revolutions leave the spinner at west, then the extra 1/4 clockwise moves it to north. The second move is 3 3/4 counterclockwise revolutions: ignore the 3 full revolutions, then move 3 quarter-turns counterclockwise from north: west, south, east. Therefore the final direction is east.
